hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the single template F(x) = V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Instantiate it by substituting x = p for the first term and x = q for the second term.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are functions of a single argument and are defined at p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical terms have the same product structure V(argument)*G0(argument)*V(argument), differing only by the symbolic argument p versus q.
